-- Use-case summary:
  - Primary product team: search + recommendations for customer-facing product analytics UI.
  - Workflow: nightly batch embed job (200k–500k docs/day) + near-real-time query path for UI (target p50 40ms, p99 <= 200ms).
  - Vector store: currently evaluating Pinecone and self-hosted Milvus; needs clear pattern for warm-up / cold-cache queries.

-- Quote / on-call snippets:
  - "If we can keep p99 under 200ms for top-10 requests we're comfortable moving to dedicated" — Head of Product.
  - "Cost leakage on token-level ops is our main fear — need predictable unit economics for embeddings + search" — CFO (paraphrase).

-- Technical constraints & preferences:
  - Prefers open/quantized embedding models; interested in Redwood's verified embeddings profiles.
  - Batch pipelines run in GCP; VPC peering required for Dedicated trials.
  - Data residency: primary US, some EU customers require EU residency for subset of docs.

-- POC specifics and acceptance criteria:
  - Ingest 200k historical docs, run nightly batch embed pipeline, validate recall@10 for 3 test prompts, measure average and p99 query latencies at target traffic (50 qps simulated).
  - Cost report for pilot: per-embedding unit cost + estimated per-query cost at 50 qps.
  - Integration recipe: sample code for direct vectorDB write vs Redwood-managed index + fallback routing to hosted model if overloaded.

-- Sales progress & tone:
  - Warm, technically savvy GTM org; procurement cycle typical for mid-market (~6–10 weeks).
  - Interested in starting on Hosted API to accelerate ship, then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput after pilot.
  - AE note: prioritize demo of Optimize suggestions (batch/quantization wins) to address cost concerns.

-- Deal risks:
  - Security questionnaire items 4.1–4.4 outstanding (DPA + encryption at rest specifics).
  - Client expects clear SLA/latency commitments on dedicated; need to align on burst pricing.

-- Quick wins to push deal forward:
  - Provide sample pilot pricing + 3-tier capacity options (dev, pilot, peak).
  - Share short tech note: "Vector DB warm-up patterns + cache TTLs for <200ms p99".
  - Run one scoped A/B showing Redwood-managed index vs direct vector DB (latency/cost comparison).
